Method of Attack: Spreads laterally through hacked corporate environments
Steals bank credentials, Windows domain credentials
Delivers further malware payloads on infected devices
Creates temporary service on target host to execute DLL using regsvr32.exe
Uses SMB file-sharing protocol to spread via default admin shares using current user credentials
Disables Windows Defender via PowerShell commands or GPO on Domain Controller
Modifies wallpaper icon, deletes shadow copies, appends .basta extension on encrypted files
Generates company ID in ransom notes
Uses Cobalt Strike beacons during compromise
Indicators of Compromise: pc_list.txt file containing internal IP addresses
